_comment: Template. Replace `question` text with the exact questions from the real claim file so the headline number is graded by the insurer's document, not by this template. Keep `answered_by` keys; they name the pack fields that satisfy each question. `by_design_unanswered` marks questions Watermark refuses to answer (cause is the adjuster's job).
source: TEMPLATE: typical Canadian home water-damage claim intake questions. Replace with the insurer's own form.

questions.question: When did you first become aware of the water?
Where in the home did the water appear?
How long was the water present before it was addressed?
Do you have photographs or video, with dates and times?
Describe the extent of the water (depth, area, surfaces affected).
What were the conditions in the room afterwards (humidity, temperature, drying)?
Were any detection devices installed and were they working at the time?
Have you had previous water incidents at this address?
Was anyone home at the time, and who entered the area?
What steps did you take to stop or mitigate the water?
What was the source or cause of the water?
